source_tool_schemas.name: search_files
source_tool_schemas.description: Search repository text files for a literal query.

source_tool_schemas.name: read_file
source_tool_schemas.description: Read a bounded range from a repository file.

source_tool_schemas.name: apply_patch
source_tool_schemas.description: Apply a raw Git unified diff to existing tracked text files within the task's allowed paths. New files, renames, copies, and binary patches are not supported. The patch must begin with 'diff --git' and contain ---/+++/@@ lines. Do not use '*** Begin Patch' or '*** End Patch' markers.

source_tool_schemas.name: run_check
source_tool_schemas.description: Run one task-registered public check by ID. A passing result is valid only for the exact current worktree diff; any later patch requires another check.

source_tool_schemas.name: get_diff
source_tool_schemas.description: Return the current Git diff and size summary. Call this after all registered checks pass for the current diff so the next turn can perform final review.

source_tool_schemas.name: finish_task
source_tool_schemas.description: Submit the current patch for deterministic evaluation. Call only after every registered check passes for the current diff and the complete final get_diff result has been reviewed in this turn.
